EngLawName: Organization Act of the National Archives Administration, National Development Council
name: 國家發展委員會檔案管理局組織法
histories: Enacted and promulgated by President Order Hua-ZongHua-Tsung (I)-Yi- No.10200156131 on August 21, 2013

articles.content: The National Development Council shall establish the National Archives Administration (hereinafter referred to as the NAA) to administer the management and access regarding records of government agencies.
The NAA shall have one Director-General at grade13, and two Deputy Directors-General at grade 12.
The NAA shall have one Chief -Secretary at grade 11.
The official ranks, grades, and number of positions of the NAA staff shall be set forth by a separate personnel establishment table.
The date of enforcement of this Act shall be prescribed by the Executive Yuan.
